base_rule: task2-final-rules-v1 (frozen; no parameter of the base rule is modified here)

L1_rolling_replay.property: exact match to final_scores at main cutoff (zero L2 loss)

D1_dual_warning_zone_door.entry: teacher_pctl>0.6 AND v3_risk_pctl>=0.5 (v1 definition, fold-frozen references)
D1_dual_warning_zone_door.extra_points: v1 sharpening value (cap 4), cleared on the day of exit
D1_dual_warning_zone_door.rejected_alternative: one-way door (no re-entry): measurably hurts discrimination; registered

night_coefficient.fleet_effect: neutral (second-order); reserved as per-driver fairness term

D3_time_knobs.selection_protocol: candidate grid scored on TRAIN folds at main cutoff (labels within train folds only), top-5 then ranked by mean BAND AUC of the anchored daily curve on train vehicles; shipped value = most conservative when fleet curve gain is absent

D4_km_window.evidence: all five folds selected the calendar window

D6_daily_restart.semantics: each day scored fresh from 100; no static-final carryover; replay-compression eliminated by construction

acceptance.dynamic_curve: prospective labels (incident within [c, c+40d)); full-series and band metrics in controlled ledger
acceptance.band_min_rule: L2 layer band minimum must not fall below the L1 rolling-replay baseline
acceptance.results_location: controlled ledger final_v1_dyn/ (phaseA / phaseB / phaseAB records)

known_boundaries: row-count caliber inherited from v1 (no 60/120/600s merging); weaker rolling stability than segment caliber -> v2-a candidate
knob learning involves multiple comparisons; fleet-level effect neutral; most conservative values shipped
